race.comment: TIMELESS GEM (6) gets the nod in the Batavia after a 2.3L defeat in Saturday company behind Cinque Stelle. That form looks very strong for a race of this calibre and he maps to get every chance from the outset. Just needs to run up to his latest effort to be going one better this time. MAGICAL SEQUENCE (5) won impressively first-up last campaign but didn't go on with it, disappointing on a Heavy deck before a short break. She'll be fitter for a recent trial and she has won 3/4 first-up. Looks set to play a leading role. BOLTA (7) finished off impressively first-up over 1100m, missing by a nose as the race favourite. He looks in good stead for a race like this though and he's won 3/5 at the track and trip. Likely to get back but should be launching a bold attack late. KINGS HONOUR (2) is better than he showed last start. While 1200m is a query, his two wins at Belmont prior stack up. SUPERSESSION (3) can feature first-up.
